# Committed real sample files

Real device files whose licence lets this repository redistribute them.
Each directory keeps its source's licence text beside the files. Files
whose licence does not allow it are fetched instead, by
`scripts/fetch-fixtures.sh`.

| File | Device | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gopro-telemetry/hero11.raw` | GoPro HERO11 Black, raw GPMF payloads with GPS5 and GPS9 (20 September 2022) | [JuanIrache/gopro-telemetry](https://github.com/JuanIrache/gopro-telemetry) `samples/hero11.raw` at commit `1b7160e4382774d89e78792153de90ce04d70216` | MIT, © 2019 Juan Irache Duesca (`gopro-telemetry/LICENSE.txt`) |
| `uopenformula/pittrace-90.csv` | AiM logger, Race Studio 3 "AiM CSV File" export (Pittsburgh International Race Complex, 1 August 2025) | [Formula-uOttawa/uOpenFormula](https://github.com/Formula-uOttawa/uOpenFormula) `_debugging_files/august_01/90.csv` at commit `cb9393e4103d44332b42ba2815fd1206196b295e` | MIT, © 2025 Formula uOttawa Contributors (`uopenformula/LICENSE`) |
